name: two-clocks
unmodelled: CONSTANT_DRIFT: 31 of 60 constants no longer match combat.md; this script predates #44 (health_units 64, resistance in points, no tick caps, fatigue). Every number it prints for this build is an observation of the old model.

Element stack batches (Effects rule 9a): the script merges one status per id and refreshes duration; Burn and Poison are separate batches with their own timers and no stack cap. stack_cap 1000 stands in for 'no cap'.
c_tick 0.02997 = Burn/Poison 0.019 x stack_effect_pct +36 % x purity (1 + 0.002 x 80). Poison's stack_duration_pct +60 % is folded into duration 16 (authored 10 s).
Burn is entered as kind qi and Poison as kind body only to split the old ward's pass shares; in the game Burn is Fire and Poison is Chaos, both meeting resistance in points.

Incense Clock (enabler): L5 payloads also apply to ticks; hits deal no damage (c_art 0 and basic c 0 model the close). The script skips L5 on ticks, so Bare Vessel, Kindled Wound, Marked Prey and Fuel for the Fire are not tested here.
Ash Ledger (identity): 20 % of the tick damage resistance stops burns the target's linh luc. Not expressible here.
Spillover (#44 form): 25 % of each tick's dealt damage burns linh luc. The script only has the retired clipped-amount form (tick_overflow_qi), so it is left out.
Embers Feed the Hearth: Burn ticks restore 25 % of their dealt damage as linh luc. Not expressible.
Drain-ward billing of ticks and the ward falling at 0 linh luc (the first clock). The script's ticks skip the ward.
Cinder Debt: cleansed stacks burn the cleanser's linh luc. Not expressible.
Sap Rising's Wood buff stacks (+0.1 pp health regeneration each) and Golden Light Shield's cast shield. Entered as cost-only arts.
Common Ward and Mountain Screen in ward slots (resistance in points, reserved shield). The ward block above is the old pass model.
